label: Ideal reactors, RTD
text: EN.O.A5.1.2 Ideal reactors: batch, continuous stirred tank (perfect mixing), plug flow (no axial mixing). Conversion against residence time; residence-time distribution diagnoses real reactors.

warrant.standard: Mass balance closure; pilot-scale agreement; property certificates
warrant.defeaters: Scale-up; impurities; kinetics confused with equilibrium
